budget_fit_inputs.authority: CHAIR ruling 1(f); lead rulings R5-4, R6-3, R7-2
budget_fit_inputs.rule: G0_cap_W1 (r1_slots.g0_cap_w1.value_s, R7-2) + max (G1 + H) + max (prefill + tool) over the gated D runs + (B_D + turn_cap_tokens) / r_decode <= T_dead, r_decode = min(step-d rate, every gated run's observed rate) (scripts/align_v4_kit.py ruling_1f_fit)

fallback_order: S6 tuning jointly for G1 and hold waits (median <= 90 s each), delta_slow capped at 2.0 C
idle 300 -> 450 s after D predecessors only
4-bit at the same rung (quantization rule trigger extended to 'duty bar fails')

schedule.rule: each gated D run and X-G follows a D turn with only W1's inter-member schedule (the member's own configured idle); no cool-to-band

g0_cap_w1.rule: G0_cap_W1 = clamp(ceil(1.25 x max G0 wait over D_bank, D_spam a, D_spam b, X-G), 600 s, R1 G0 timeout); an unreleased G0, or an X-G that is not measured (x_g_fallback), counts at the R1 G0 timeout; ruling 1(f) uses value_s as its G0 term

projected_mde.formula: MDE ~= q * s_r,D / e_D (CHAIR section C)
